reason: A DSH plugin that monitors per-session context usage, lets users configure a threshold, and automatically compacts context when the threshold is exceeded.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 会话显示实时上下文用量并提供会话级阈值设置，在超过阈值时自动执行上下文压缩。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin that displays real-time session context usage, supports per-session thresholds, and automatically compacts context when usage exceeds the threshold.

capabilities: Stores a configurable compaction threshold per session
Automatically triggers context compaction when the threshold is exceeded
Adds a threshold control interface to the conversation input area
